subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I learn best when I can use the language in real situations.
portuguese: Aprendo melhor quando consigo usar a língua em situações reais.
pronunciationNote: ah-PREN-doo meh-LYOR KWAN-doo kon-SEE-goo oo-ZAR ah LEEN-gwah eng see-too-ah-SOYNH rreh-AISH
notes: Useful for explaining your learning style.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Em vez de decorar listas, aprendo melhor quando consigo usar a língua em situações reais.
exampleSentences.english: Instead of memorising lists, I learn best when I can use the language in real situations.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need to work on my listening comprehension.
portuguese: Preciso de trabalhar a minha compreensão oral.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d trah-bah-LYAR ah MEE-nyah kom-preh-en-SOWN oh-RAL
notes: Useful for describing specific weaknesses.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Consigo ler bastante bem, mas preciso de trabalhar a minha compreensão oral.
exampleSentences.english: I can read quite well, but I need to work on my listening comprehension.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I lose track when too many new words appear at once.
portuguese: Perco-me quando aparecem demasiadas palavras novas ao mesmo tempo.
pronunciationNote: PAIR-koo-m KWAN-doo ah-pah-REH-seng deh-mah-ZYAH-dash pah-LAHV-rash NOH-vash ow MAY-zmoo TEM-poo
notes: Useful for describing a common learning problem.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nos podcasts mais rápidos, perco-me quando aparecem demasiadas palavras novas ao mesmo tempo.
exampleSentences.english: In faster podcasts, I lose track when too many new words appear at once.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: Could you give us a more natural example?
portuguese: Podia dar-nos um exemplo mais natural?
pronunciationNote: POH-dee-ah dar-noosh oom eh-ZEM-ploo mysh nah-too-RAL
notes: Useful when textbook examples feel unnatural.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Percebo a regra, mas podia dar-nos um exemplo mais natural?
exampleSentences.english: I understand the rule, but could you give us a more natural example?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I understand the rule, but I struggle to apply it in conversation.
portuguese: Percebo a regra, mas tenho dificuldade em aplicá-la na conversa.
pronunciationNote: pehr-SEH-boo ah RREH-grah mash TEN-yoo dee-fee-kool-DAH-d eng ah-plee-KAH-lah nah kon-VER-sah
grammarFocus: contrast with mas and object pronoun
notes: Useful for describing the gap between theory and practice.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nos exercícios corre bem, mas percebo a regra e tenho dificuldade em aplicá-la na conversa.
exampleSentences.english: It goes well in exercises, but although I understand the rule, I struggle to apply it in conversation.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I would rather practise speaking than do another worksheet.
portuguese: Preferia praticar a expressão oral em vez de fazer outra ficha.
pronunciationNote: preh-feh-REE-ah prah-tee-KAR ah ekspreh-SOWN oh-RAL eng vesh d fah-ZAIR OH-trah FEE-shah
notes: Useful for suggesting a different activity.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje preferia praticar a expressão oral em vez de fazer outra ficha.
exampleSentences.english: Today I would rather practise speaking than do another worksheet.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: This explanation makes sense now that I have seen it in context.
portuguese: Esta explicação faz sentido agora que a vi em contexto.
pronunciationNote: ESH-tah eks-plee-kah-SOWN faz sen-TEE-doo ah-GOH-rah k ah vee eng kon-TESH-too
notes: Useful when something finally clicks.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nos exemplos isolados eu não percebia, mas esta explicação faz sentido agora que a vi em contexto.
exampleSentences.english: I did not understand it in isolated examples, but this explanation makes sense now that I have seen it in context.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I keep mixing these two tenses up.
portuguese: Continuo a confundir estes dois tempos verbais.
pronunciationNote: kon-tee-NOO ah kong-foon-DEER ESH-tsh doish TEM-poosh vehr-BAISH
notes: Useful for grammar problems that persist.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mesmo depois de praticar, continuo a confundir estes dois tempos verbais.
exampleSentences.english: Even after practising, I keep mixing these two tenses up.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: Would it be possible to record this part of the lesson?
portuguese: Seria possível gravar esta parte da aula?
pronunciationNote: seh-REE-ah poh-SEE-vel grah-VAR ESH-tah PAR-t dah OW-lah
notes: Useful when you want to review something later.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Como esta parte é importante, seria possível gravar esta parte da aula?
exampleSentences.english: Since this part is important, would it be possible to record this part of the lesson?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I can usually follow the lesson, but I miss some of the details.
portuguese: Normalmente consigo acompanhar a aula, mas falham-me alguns pormenores.
pronunciationNote: nor-mal-MEN-t kon-SEE-goo ah-kom-pah-NYAR ah OW-lah mash fal-yang-m ah-GOONSH por-meh-NOR-sh
notes: Useful for describing partial comprehension.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se falam depressa, normalmente consigo acompanhar a aula, mas falham-me alguns pormenores.
exampleSentences.english: If they speak quickly, I can usually follow the lesson, but I miss some of the details.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need feedback that is more specific than just right or wrong.
portuguese: Preciso de comentários mais específicos do que apenas certo ou errado.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d koh-men-TAH-ree-oosh mysh esh-peh-SEE-fee-koosh doo k ah-peh-NASH SAIR-too oo eh-RRAH-doo
notes: Useful when you want better correction.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para melhorar a escrita, preciso de comentários mais específicos do que apenas certo ou errado.
exampleSentences.english: To improve my writing, I need feedback that is more specific than just right or wrong.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I remember words better if I use them in a sentence.
portuguese: Memorizo melhor as palavras se as usar numa frase.
pronunciationNote: meh-moh-REE-zoo meh-LYOR az pah-LAHV-rash s ahz oo-ZAR NOO-mah FRAH-z
notes: Useful for describing study techniques.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Em vez de decorar listas, memorizo melhor as palavras se as usar numa frase.
exampleSentences.english: Instead of memorising lists, I remember words better if I use them in a sentence.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: This assignment is more time-consuming than I expected.
portuguese: Este trabalho dá mais trabalho do que eu esperava.
pronunciationNote: ESH-t trah-BAH-lyoo dah mysh trah-BAH-lyoo doo k eh-oo esh-peh-RAH-vah
notes: A natural phrase for saying something takes effort.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Como também exige pesquisa, este trabalho dá mais trabalho do que eu esperava.
exampleSentences.english: Since it also requires research, this assignment is more time-consuming than I expected.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I have been putting this off because I was not sure how to start.
portuguese: Andei a adiar isto porque não tinha a certeza de como começar.
pronunciationNote: an-DAY ah ah-dee-AR EESH-too por-k nown TEEN-yah ah tehr-TEH-zah d KOH-moo koo-meh-SAR
notes: Useful for admitting procrastination.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para ser sincero, andei a adiar isto porque não tinha a certeza de como começar.
exampleSentences.english: To be honest, I have been putting this off because I was not sure how to start.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: Could we go over that point once more?
portuguese: Podíamos voltar a esse ponto mais uma vez?
pronunciationNote: poo-DEE-ah-moosh vol-TAR ah EH-s pooing-too mysh OO-mah vez
notes: Useful in group classes.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Antes de passar à frente, podíamos voltar a esse ponto mais uma vez?
exampleSentences.english: Before moving on, could we go over that point once more?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I am trying to rely less on translation.
portuguese: Estou a tentar depender menos da tradução.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR deh-pen-DER MEN-oosh dah trah-doo-SOWN
notes: Useful for talking about learning strategies.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para pensar mais depressa, estou a tentar depender menos da tradução.
exampleSentences.english: To think faster, I am trying to rely less on translation.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: This wording sounds too literal to me.
portuguese: Esta formulação soa-me demasiado literal.
pronunciationNote: ESH-tah for-moo-lah-SOWN SOH-ah-m deh-mah-ZYAH-doo lee-teh-RAL
notes: Useful for discussing style and nuance.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Talvez esteja correta, mas esta formulação soa-me demasiado literal.
exampleSentences.english: It may be correct, but this wording sounds too literal to me.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: What would sound more natural here?
portuguese: O que soaria mais natural aqui?
pronunciationNote: oo k soh-ah-REE-ah mysh nah-too-RAL ah-KEE
notes: Useful for asking about natural phrasing.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se eu quisesse dizer isto como um nativo, o que soaria mais natural aqui?
exampleSentences.english: If I wanted to say this like a native speaker, what would sound more natural here?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I can understand much more than I can say.
portuguese: Consigo perceber muito mais do que consigo dizer.
pronunciationNote: kon-SEE-goo pehr-seh-BER MOO-too mysh doo k kon-SEE-goo deh-ZAIR
notes: Useful for describing receptive versus active ability.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando o tema me é familiar, consigo perceber muito mais do que consigo dizer.
exampleSentences.english: When the topic is familiar to me, I can understand much more than I can say.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need more opportunities to speak without preparing in advance.
portuguese: Preciso de mais oportunidades para falar sem preparar tudo de antemão.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d mysh oh-por-too-nee-dah-DESH PAH-rah fah-LAR seng preh-pah-RAR TOO-doo d an-teh-MOWN
notes: Useful for talking about spontaneous speaking practice.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nas aulas consigo responder, mas preciso de mais oportunidades para falar sem preparar tudo de antemão.
exampleSentences.english: In class I can answer, but I need more opportunities to speak without preparing everything in advance.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I am trying to build a steadier study routine.
portuguese: Estou a tentar criar uma rotina de estudo mais consistente.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR kree-AR OO-mah rroh-TEE-nah d esh-TOO-doo mysh kon-seesh-TEN-t
notes: Useful for talking about habits.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Em vez de estudar só de vez em quando, estou a tentar criar uma rotina de estudo mais consistente.
exampleSentences.english: Instead of studying only now and then, I am trying to build a steadier study routine.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: It helps when the corrections explain why something is wrong.
portuguese: Ajuda quando as correções explicam porque é que algo está errado.
pronunciationNote: ah-ZHOO-dah KWAN-doo az koh-rreh-SOYNH eks-plee-KANG por-k eh k AL-goo esh-TAH eh-RRAH-doo
grammarFocus: subordinate clause with porque é que
notes: Useful when discussing teaching methods.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para eu não repetir o erro, ajuda quando as correções explicam porque é que algo está errado.
exampleSentences.english: So I do not repeat the mistake, it helps when corrections explain why something is wrong.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I have improved, but I am still not as fluent as I would like.
portuguese: Melhorei, mas ainda não sou tão fluente como gostaria.
pronunciationNote: meh-lyoh-RAY mash een-DAH nown soh town floo-EN-t KOH-moo goosh-tah-REE-ah
notes: Useful for balanced self-assessment.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Perco menos tempo a pensar, mas melhorei e ainda não sou tão fluente como gostaria.
exampleSentences.english: I spend less time thinking, but although I have improved, I am still not as fluent as I would like.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: This chapter is dense, so I need to read it twice.
portuguese: Este capítulo é denso, por isso preciso de o ler duas vezes.
pronunciationNote: ESH-t kah-PEE-too-loo eh DEN-soo poor EE-soo preh-SEE-zoo d oo lair DOO-ash VAY-zesh
notes: Useful for talking about reading difficulty.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Como introduz muitos conceitos novos, este capítulo é denso, por isso preciso de o ler duas vezes.
exampleSentences.english: Since it introduces many new concepts, this chapter is dense, so I need to read it twice.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I learn more from short, regular sessions than from long cram sessions.
portuguese: Aprendo mais com sessões curtas e regulares do que com maratonas de estudo.
pronunciationNote: ah-PREN-doo mysh kong seh-SOYNH KOOR-tash ee rreh-goo-LAH-rash doo k kong mah-rah-TOH-nash d esh-TOO-doo
notes: Useful for discussing study habits.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim, aprendo mais com sessões curtas e regulares do que com maratonas de estudo.
exampleSentences.english: For me, I learn more from short, regular sessions than from long cram sessions.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I would like to focus more on vocabulary related to everyday life.
portuguese: Gostava de me concentrar mais no vocabulário ligado ao quotidiano.
pronunciationNote: goosh-TAH-vah d m kong-sen-TRAR mysh noo voh-kah-boo-LAH-ree-oo lee-GAH-doo ow koh-tee-dee-AH-noo
notes: Useful for shaping course content.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Como vivo cá, gostava de me concentrar mais no vocabulário ligado ao quotidiano.
exampleSentences.english: Since I live here, I would like to focus more on vocabulary related to everyday life.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: The hardest part is turning passive knowledge into active use.
portuguese: A parte mais difícil é transformar conhecimento passivo em uso ativo.
pronunciationNote: ah PAR-t mysh dee-FEE-seel eh trans-for-MAR koo-nyeh-see-MEN-too pah-SEE-voo eng OO-zoo AH-tee-voo
notes: Useful for reflecting on language learning.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Sei muitas palavras, mas a parte mais difícil é transformar conhecimento passivo em uso ativo.
exampleSentences.english: I know many words, but the hardest part is turning passive knowledge into active use.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: Could you recommend something to read at my level?
portuguese: Podia recomendar-me algo para ler ao meu nível?
pronunciationNote: POH-dee-ah rreh-ko-men-DAR-m AL-goo PAH-rah lair ow may-oo NEE-vel
grammarFocus: polite request with indirect object pronoun
notes: Useful when asking for resources.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Queria ler mais fora das aulas. Podia recomendar-me algo para ler ao meu nível?
exampleSentences.english: I wanted to read more outside class. Could you recommend something to read at my level?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I am trying to get used to the European Portuguese accent.
portuguese: Estou a tentar habituar-me ao sotaque do português europeu.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR ah-bee-too-AR-m ow soh-TAK doo por-too-GUEZ eh-oo-roh-PAI-oo
notes: Useful for this specific app's focus.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Como antes ouvia mais brasileiro, estou a tentar habituar-me ao sotaque do português europeu.
exampleSentences.english: Since I used to hear more Brazilian Portuguese, I am trying to get used to the European Portuguese accent.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: It takes me a while to process longer sentences.
portuguese: Levo algum tempo a processar frases mais longas.
pronunciationNote: LEH-voh al-GOONG TEM-poo ah proh-seh-SAR FRAH-zesh mysh LONG-gash
notes: Useful for explaining processing difficulty.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando falam depressa, levo algum tempo a processar frases mais longas.
exampleSentences.english: When people speak quickly, it takes me a while to process longer sentences.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I would find it useful to have more speaking pair work.
portuguese: Acharia útil haver mais trabalho em pares para falar.
pronunciationNote: ah-shah-REE-ah OO-teel ah-VAIR mysh trah-BAH-lyoo eng PAI-resh PAH-rah fah-LAR
notes: Useful for feedback about classes.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para praticarmos mais, acharia útil haver mais trabalho em pares para falar.
exampleSentences.english: So that we can practise more, I would find it useful to have more speaking pair work.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I tend to hesitate when I have to improvise.
portuguese: Costumo hesitar quando tenho de improvisar.
pronunciationNote: koosh-TOO-moo eh-zee-TAR KWAN-doo TEN-yoo d eem-proh-vee-ZAR
notes: Useful for explaining speaking anxiety.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se não preparei o tema antes, costumo hesitar quando tenho de improvisar.
exampleSentences.english: If I have not prepared the topic beforehand, I tend to hesitate when I have to improvise.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need to stop translating word for word in my head.
portuguese: Preciso de deixar de traduzir palavra por palavra na minha cabeça.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d day-SHAR d trah-doo-ZEER pah-LAHV-rah poor pah-LAHV-rah nah MEE-nyah kah-BEH-sah
notes: Useful for describing a common learner habit.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para falar com mais naturalidade, preciso de deixar de traduzir palavra por palavra na minha cabeça.
exampleSentences.english: To speak more naturally, I need to stop translating word for word in my head.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: This course has helped me become more consistent.
portuguese: Este curso ajudou-me a ser mais consistente.
pronunciationNote: ESH-t KOOR-soo ah-zhoo-DOW-m ah sair mysh kon-seesh-TEN-t
notes: Useful for course feedback.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Antes estudava sem rotina, mas este curso ajudou-me a ser mais consistente.
exampleSentences.english: Before, I studied without a routine, but this course has helped me become more consistent.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I still need time to formulate my ideas before I speak.
portuguese: Ainda preciso de tempo para formular as minhas ideias antes de falar.
pronunciationNote: een-DAH preh-SEE-zoo d TEM-poo PAH-rah for-moo-LAR az MEE-nyash ee-DAY-ash AN-tesh d fah-LAR
notes: Useful for describing speaking pace.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mesmo quando conheço o vocabulário, ainda preciso de tempo para formular as minhas ideias antes de falar.
exampleSentences.english: Even when I know the vocabulary, I still need time to formulate my ideas before I speak.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: What matters most to me is being able to handle everyday conversations.
portuguese: O que mais me importa é conseguir lidar com conversas do dia a dia.
pronunciationNote: oo k mysh m eem-POR-tah eh kon-seh-GEER lee-DAR kong kon-VER-sash doo DEE-ah ah DEE-ah
notes: Useful for explaining your practical goals.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não procuro perfeição. O que mais me importa é conseguir lidar com conversas do dia a dia.
exampleSentences.english: I am not looking for perfection. What matters most to me is being able to handle everyday conversations.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I am more confident reading than speaking.
portuguese: Sinto-me mais confiante a ler do que a falar.
pronunciationNote: SEEN-too-m mysh kon-fee-AN-t ah lair doo k ah fah-LAR
notes: Useful for comparing skills.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Como tenho mais tempo para pensar, sinto-me mais confiante a ler do que a falar.
exampleSentences.english: Since I have more time to think, I am more confident reading than speaking.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I would rather review fewer words properly than rush through a long list.
portuguese: Preferia rever menos palavras em condições do que despachar uma lista longa à pressa.

notes: Useful for discussing study quality over quantity.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para fixar melhor, preferia rever menos palavras em condições do que despachar uma lista longa à pressa.
exampleSentences.english: To retain them better, I would rather review fewer words properly than rush through a long list.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: If I do not revise regularly, I forget things surprisingly quickly.
portuguese: Se não revejo com regularidade, esqueço-me das coisas mais depressa do que esperava.

notes: Useful for describing memory and revision.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mesmo quando acho que já sei, se não revejo com regularidade, esqueço-me das coisas mais depressa do que esperava.
exampleSentences.english: Even when I think I know them already, if I do not revise regularly, I forget things surprisingly quickly.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: This feedback is useful because it points to patterns in my mistakes.
portuguese: Este feedback é útil porque aponta para padrões nos meus erros.
pronunciationNote: ESH-t FEED-bak eh OO-teel por-k ah-POON-tah PAH-rah pah-DROYNH noosh may-oosh EH-rroosh
notes: Useful for discussing detailed correction.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não corrige só um exercício. Este feedback é útil porque aponta para padrões nos meus erros.
exampleSentences.english: It does not just correct one exercise. This feedback is useful because it points to patterns in my mistakes.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I am trying to sound less rehearsed and more spontaneous.
portuguese: Estou a tentar soar menos ensaiado e mais espontâneo.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR soh-AR MEN-oosh en-sah-YAH-doo ee mysh esh-pon-TAH-neh-oo
notes: Useful when talking about speaking style.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando preparo demasiado, noto isso. Estou a tentar soar menos ensaiado e mais espontâneo.
exampleSentences.english: When I prepare too much, I notice it. I am trying to sound less rehearsed and more spontaneous.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I would benefit from more tasks that reflect real-life situations.
portuguese: Faria-me bem ter mais tarefas que reflitam situações da vida real.
pronunciationNote: fah-REE-ah-m beng tair mysh TAR-fash k rreh-FLEE-tang see-too-ah-SOYNH dah VEE-dah rreh-AL
notes: Useful for course feedback.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para o meu caso, faria-me bem ter mais tarefas que reflitam situações da vida real.
exampleSentences.english: For my situation, I would benefit from more tasks that reflect real-life situations.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I need to push myself to speak even when I am unsure.
portuguese: Preciso de me obrigar a falar mesmo quando não tenho a certeza.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d m oh-bree-GAR ah fah-LAR MAY-zmoo KWAN-doo nown TEN-yoo ah tehr-TEH-zah
notes: Useful for talking about confidence and effort.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se esperar pela frase perfeita, não avanço. Preciso de me obrigar a falar mesmo quando não tenho a certeza.
exampleSentences.english: If I wait for the perfect sentence, I do not move forward. I need to push myself to speak even when I am unsure.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I notice the gap between what I recognise and what I can produce.
portuguese: Noto a diferença entre aquilo que reconheço e aquilo que consigo produzir.

notes: Useful for talking about receptive and productive knowledge.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ao ouvir ou ler, noto a diferença entre aquilo que reconheço e aquilo que consigo produzir.
exampleSentences.english: When listening or reading, I notice the gap between what I recognise and what I can produce.

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: Could you point out the mistakes that sound unnatural rather than just incorrect?
portuguese: Podia assinalar os erros que soam pouco naturais, e não apenas os que estão incorretos?

notes: Useful for advanced correction requests.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para eu soar melhor, podia assinalar os erros que soam pouco naturais, e não apenas os que estão incorretos?
exampleSentences.english: So that I sound better, could you point out the mistakes that sound unnatural rather than just incorrect?

subject: Education, Study & Learning
english: I am starting to think directly in Portuguese in some situations.
portuguese: Estou a começar a pensar diretamente em português em algumas situações.
